First release of OpenElixir-02, custom firmware for the Erica Synths LXR-02 drum machine.

> **Pre-release.** This build has not been tested on hardware yet. OpenElixir-02 is not official
> Erica Synths firmware and is not affiliated with or approved by Erica Synths. Install it at your
> own risk.

## Changes from the stock firmware (1.7)

- **No more hard clipping in the mix.** Voices and FX are summed in 32 bit, followed by a limiter on
  each output. Kits that didn't clip before sound exactly the same; louder ones are limited instead
  of clipped. Voice drive/distortion and the FX are unchanged.
- **Renamed to OpenElixir-02.** The start-up screen shows "OpenElixir-02 / Version 0.1" and the
  device appears as "OpenElixir-02" (manufacturer "tunefish.at") on USB. MIDI mappings in your DAW
  that use the old "Sonic Potions USB MIDI" port name need to be set up again.
- **Memory usage report** in every build (developer change, no effect on the device).

Kits, patterns, projects and the MIDI implementation are unchanged.

## Installing

1. Download `LXR_OpenElixir-02_V0.1.img` below.
2. Copy it to the top folder of the SD card and delete any other `LXR*.img` files there.
3. Switch the LXR-02 off, insert the card, hold the encoder button and switch it on. Keep holding
   until "LXR Updater" appears.
4. Wait for "Update OK!". The device restarts with the new firmware.

To go back, install the official firmware update from Erica Synths the same way.

The `.hex` and `.elf` files are for programming and debugging with an ST-Link; you don't need them for
a normal update.
